title: JANUS UAP Domain Index — 2026-08-15

authority_boundary.reason: This is a navigation/read-order update only. JPFM-2E through JPFM-3D materially sharpen the open evidence, but none is promoted to canonical authority.

POSS1_NUCLEAR_SCHEDULE_SPECIFICITY.current_result: For the dense public S0 cohort, ANY_CANDIDATE is exactly identical to PALOMAR_OBSERVED_NIGHT on all 312 observed nights. The nominal all-calendar nuclear association is therefore an observation-schedule association. Conditional candidate-rate models do not show a robust positive nuclear enhancement.

BLUE_BOOK_HUMAN_WITNESS_TEMPORAL_SPECIFI.current_result: The reconstructed exact-date Blue Book layer contains a clearly nonzero STARLIKE baseline away from nuclear dates. At +/-1 day there is no positive STARLIKE enrichment, and July 1952 remains a strong non-nuclear positive-control epoch.

jpfm_3a.result: No preregistered common external-event family among sunspot level, geomagnetic storm, meteor-shower proxy, lunar extremes or direct Blue Book STARLIKE-day overlap passed the cross-layer gate.
jpfm_3a.important_boundary: Same-day Blue Book STARLIKE to POSS-I rate was nominally positive but non-significant and based on only seven overlapping observed Palomar nights.

jpfm_3c.result: Official NOAA H-alpha event dates, qualified by real flare-patrol opportunity, did not enrich Blue Book STARLIKE reports. The POSS exact-day NB2 coefficient was negative, but the 720-minute primary retained only 20 Palomar nights with 18 flare versus two non-flare controls.

jpfm_3d.role: Finite-sample post-3C identifiability repair, not independent confirmation.
jpfm_3d.primary_720: Observed crude rate ratio 0.8036; exact year-stratified lower-tail p=0.1111 over all 45 admissible label placements. Negative pattern not retained.
jpfm_3d.sensitivity_360: Negative one-sided pattern is stronger on the relaxed 360-minute sensitivity, but by preregistration this sensitivity cannot rescue the failed 720-minute primary.

OPEN_POSS1_REPRODUCIBILITY.important_boundary: The 122,820-candidate public cohort is independently selected and is not byte-identical to the unavailable 107,875-source closed VASCO sample.

OPEN_BLUE_BOOK_REPRODUCIBILITY.important_boundary: The public mirror is not established as a complete/unbiased denominator for all historical Blue Book reports.

HISTORICAL_CLOSED_SAMPLE_REPRODUCIBILITY.blocker: Exact closed 107,875-source VASCO bytes remain unavailable; independent open tests continue without them.

LEGACY_AND_INTERPRETIVE_BRANCHES.hard_boundary: Legacy nuclear/UAP correlations and interpretive cosmology cannot be promoted over current corrective open controls.

current_open_source_context.nuclear_calendar: Nominal all-calendar photographic association is schedule-confounded in the dense S0 public cohort; no robust positive rate enhancement conditional on observation.
current_open_source_context.human_witness: No positive nuclear STARLIKE specificity; non-nuclear STARLIKE baseline clearly nonzero.
current_open_source_context.broad_external_event_atlas: No preregistered shared cross-layer pattern admitted in JPFM-3A.
current_open_source_context.halpha: No shared H-alpha human+photographic trigger admitted. Negative POSS coefficient from the sparse 3C NB2 model failed the 720-minute exact finite-sample repair in JPFM-3D.
current_open_source_context.next_external_class: Human-made sky events with explicit manifest completeness/opportunity: sounding rockets/V-2 and high-altitude balloon operations.

next_read_order_for_execution: 1. Read JPFM-2E, JPFM-3A, JPFM-3C corrective audit and JPFM-3D in that order before interpreting any calendar coincidence.
2. Open a human-made sky-event acquisition gate before inspecting Blue Book/POSS-I coincidences.
3. For sounding rockets, distinguish positive-event catalog coverage from a true all-launch denominator; scientifically successful-only catalogs cannot define no-launch dates by themselves.
4. For high-altitude balloons, freeze operation start/end, launch-day counts, pauses and weather/operational opportunity before creating negative dates.
5. When a complete event manifest is admitted, test Blue Book STARLIKE and POSS-I as separate channels first; a shared-trigger claim requires both channels to survive their frozen nulls.
6. Continue immutable Blue Book source validation and POSS-I morphology/footprint controls in parallel.
7. Only explicitly admitted results may change current-authority.
integrity_rules: This file is navigation, not evidence.
Historical evidence artifacts remain append-only provenance records.
No observation and observed zero are different states.
No catalog row and verified no event are different states.
A positive-only event manifest cannot define negative control dates.
A sensitivity threshold cannot rescue a failed preregistered primary endpoint.
A small asymptotic p-value from a sparse high-dimensional model is not sufficient when an exact finite-sample repair fails.
Any future current-authority pointer must target an explicitly admitted canonical artifact.
